newsitem.title: ITALY: Allies plan big exercise in NATO south region.
newsitem.headline: Allies plan big exercise in NATO south region.

text.p: Allied forces will conduct what is due to be the biggest military exercise in NATO's southern region this year in a combined land, sea and air exercise in the Mediterranean and Aegean seas, the U.S. Navy said on Monday.
The U.S. Sixth Fleet said in a statement that the training would take place in two segments -- Exercise Dynamic Mix from September 19 to October 6 and Damsel Fair (September 16-30).
It said military units from Belgium, Canada, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, Turkey, Britain and the United States would participate.
About 14,000 U.S. sailors and marines would participate in the exercise "to improve unit and task force readiness to conduct sustained operations within NATO's southern region".
